about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Apple Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí iPhony, Macy, iPady a další elektroniku a prodává k nim software a služby.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Eli Lilly and Company
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 18 countries. Its products are sold in approximately 125 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyrábí léky na cukrovku a obezitu (Mounjaro, Zepbound), rakovinu a další onemocnění.

about.label: ASML Holding
about.summary: Dutch company that develops and manufactures photolithography machines used to produce integrated circuits.
about.summary_cs: Nizozemská firma, jediný výrobce litografických strojů, bez kterých nejde vyrábět nejmodernější čipy.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Visa Inc.
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Visa, největší na světě.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Johnson & Johnson
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí léky a zdravotnické prostředky.

about.label: Lam Research
about.summary: American supplier of wafer-fabrication equipment and related services to the semiconductor industry.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro výrobu čipů, hlavně pro leptání a nanášení vrstev.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává zařízení, služby a software pro výrobu čipů, displejů a solárních panelů.

about.label: Mastercard
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York.
industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Mastercard.

about.label: Merck KGaA
about.summary: German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, with about 60,000 employees and a presence in 66 countries. Merck was founded in 1668 and is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company, as well as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally.
about.summary_cs: Německá vědecko-technologická firma, která vyrábí léky, laboratorní potřeby a materiály pro elektroniku.

about.label: Costco
about.summary: American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec velkoobchodních prodejen, do kterých se nakupuje s členskou kartou.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things, domain security, videoconferencing, and ener
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: Caterpillar Inc.
about.summary: American manufacturer of construction, mining, and other engineering equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce stavebních a těžebních strojů, motorů a turbín.

about.label: The Coca-Cola Company
about.summary: American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů, mimo jiné Coca-Coly, Sprite a Fanty.

about.label: Palantir Technologies
about.summary: American publicly traded company that develops data integration and analytics software.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, která dodává platformy pro analýzu dat a umělou inteligenci vládám, armádám i firmám.

about.label: Netflix, Inc.
about.summary: American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios and the Albuquerque Studios.
about.summary_cs: Americká streamovací služba s filmy a seriály, která sama vyrábí velkou část svého obsahu.

about.label: Procter & Gamble
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce drogerie a hygienických potřeb se značkami jako Pampers, Gillette, Ariel a Head & Shoulders.

about.label: KLA Corporation
about.summary: American company based in Milpitas, California that makes wafer fab equipment.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro kontrolu a měření čipů při jejich výrobě.

about.label: GE Aerospace
about.summary: American aircraft engine supplier that is headquartered in Evendale, Ohio, outside Cincinnati.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce leteckých motorů pro dopravní i vojenská letadla.

about.label: Novartis
about.summary: Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis manufactures the drugs clozapine, diclofenac, carbamazepine, valsartan, imatinib mesylate, cyclosporine, letrozole, methylphenidate, terbinafine, deferasirox, and others.
about.summary_cs: Švýcarská farmaceutická firma z Basileje, která vyvíjí léky na rakovinu, srdeční a imunitní onemocnění.

about.label: AstraZeneca
about.summary: Swedish–British multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company with its headquarters at the Cambridge Biomedical Campus in Cambridge, England. It has a portfolio of products for major diseases in areas including oncology, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, infection,  neuroscience, respiratory, and inflammation.
about.summary_cs: Britsko-švédská farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na rakovinu, srdeční a plicní onemocnění.

about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce analogových čipů a procesorů pro průmysl a auta.

about.label: MediaTek
about.summary: Taiwanese fabless semiconductor company that designs and markets a range of semiconductor products, providing chips for wireless communications, high-definition television, handheld mobile devices like smartphones and tablet computers, navigation systems, consumer multimedia products and digital subscriber line services as well as optical disc drives.
about.summary_cs: Tchajwanská firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily, televize a další elektroniku.

about.label: Arista Networks
about.summary: American provider of client to cloud networking services for large data center/AI, campus and routing environments.
about.summary_cs: Americký dodavatel síťových technologií pro velká datová centra, AI a firemní sítě.

about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na HIV, žloutenku a rakovinu.

about.label: Advantest
about.summary: Japanese leading manufacturer of automatic test equipment for the semiconductor industry, and a manufacturer of measuring instruments used in the design, production and maintenance of electronic systems including fiber optic and wireless communications equipment and digital consumer products.
about.summary_cs: Přední japonský výrobce automatických testovacích zařízení pro polovodičový průmysl a měřicích přístrojů pro elektroniku a komunikační techniku.

about.label: Amphenol
about.summary: One of the largest designers, manufacturers and marketers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial, high-speed, fiber optic, and specialty cable.
about.summary_cs: Jeden z největších výrobců elektrických a optických konektorů, antén, senzorů a speciálních kabelů.

about.label: Nestlé
about.summary: Swiss multinational food and drink processing conglomerate corporation headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland.
about.summary_cs: Švýcarský výrobce potravin a nápojů, největší na světě, se značkami jako Nescafé, KitKat a Maggi.

about.label: Linde Group
about.summary: Global multinational chemical company and the world's largest industrial gas supplier by market share and revenue.
about.summary_cs: Nadnárodní chemická firma, největší dodavatel průmyslových plynů na světě.

about.label: BHP Group
about.summary: Australian multinational mining and metals corporation.
about.summary_cs: Australská nadnárodní těžební společnost, která těží kovy a suroviny.

about.label: Tokyo Electron
about.summary: Japanese electronics and semiconductor company headquartered in Akasaka, Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan. Founded as Tokyo Electron Laboratories, Inc. in 1963, TEL is best known as a supplier of equipment to fabricate integrated circuits, flat panel displays, and photovoltaic cells.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce zařízení pro výrobu čipů a displejů.

about.label: TJX Companies
about.summary: American multinational off-price department store corporation, headquartered in Framingham, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec diskontních obchodů s oblečením a vybavením domácnosti, mimo jiné TJ Maxx a TK Maxx.

about.label: Union Pacific Corporation
about.summary: American publicly traded railroad holding company serving as the holding company for the Union Pacific Railroad.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje nákladní železnici na západě USA.

about.label: PepsiCo
about.summary: American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York, in the hamlet of Purchase. PepsiCo's business encompasses all aspects of the food and beverage market.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů a snacků se značkami Pepsi, Lay's, Doritos a Gatorade.

about.label: ABB Group
about.summary: Swedish-Swiss technology company, that operates in the fields of electrification and automation.
about.summary_cs: Švédsko-švýcarská technologická firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro elektrifikaci a průmyslovou automatizaci, včetně robotů.

about.label: Qualcomm
about.summary: American multinational technology corporation headquartered in San Diego, California. The company develops and designs technologies for global communications and computing, including next-generation mobile networks, smart devices, and semiconductors — such as mobile processors and artificial intelligence chips.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro mobily a bezdrátovou komunikaci a licencuje své patenty.

about.label: Eaton Corporation
about.summary: American multinational power management company, with a primary administrative center in Beachwood, Ohio. Eaton has more than 85,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americko-irská firma, která vyrábí zařízení pro rozvod a řízení elektrické energie a prodává je ve více než 175 zemích.

about.label: Recruit Holdings
about.summary: HR Tech holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. In FY 2024, it reported sales of 3.56 trillion Yen and revenue of 678.8 billion Yen, with more than half of its sales generated overseas.
about.summary_cs: Japonská firma, která provozuje pracovní portály jako Indeed a Glassdoor a personální agentury.

about.label: Unilever
about.summary: British multinational consumer packaged goods company headquartered in London, England. It was founded in 1930 following the merger of Dutch margarine producer Margarine Unie with British soap maker Lever Brothers.
about.summary_cs: Britský výrobce potravin, kosmetiky a drogerie se značkami jako Dove, Rexona, Knorr a Hellmann's.

about.label: American Express
about.summary: American bank holding company and multinational financial services corporation that specializes in payment cards.
industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká finanční firma, která vydává platební karty a sama zpracovává platby.
